label: large-pg-r3-head
scenarioDescription: annotation of five ~2 KB notes, five events, answered once stored

load.model: open loop, fixed arrival rate; latency from each operation's scheduled time

resources.samplers: /proc every 1000ms; jstat -gc -t <pid> 1000 per JVM; one docker stats stream; one mongosh and one psql session sampling every 1000ms; allocations over JMX connections opened at the warm-up; all started at the warm-up
